qualification: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in CS or a related technical discipline.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025

qualification: Bachelor's degree with outstanding academic achievement and leadership capacity.
description: Prestigous international award supporting outstanding applicants to pursue full-time postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.
